storyInfo: Eloysius looks for Vetochki, inspiring her to tell the people about what happened in the Far North, so that she can push for the passing of The Winter Emergency Resource Allocation Act at the citizen's forum. In the sealed district, Alita helps the Rhodes Islanders out of trouble. The assembled Infected fighters discover a ghastly sight within the 'factory'.

attributes.content: There are none left. Absolutely none. The entire way here, there have been no Infected who failed to get aid and shelter.
'I made the right decision.'
'I made the right decision.'
As she walked to the treatment center, she told herself this, over and over.
But... what next? What must she do to make this situation a lasting one?
...I see.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Elotta, you should know that the red on an Imperial Guardsman's uniform represents the red of blood.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: A soldier who slew countless enemies on the battlefield used his torn uniform to hold his spilling intestines inside his body as he crawled back to camp, all so he could celebrate a momentary victory for his comrades who would not return.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: When he died, his blood had soaked through the makeshift bandages, clinging tightly to his stiffening body and sticking to his abdomen.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Correct. Which is why you do not need to worry yourself too much about this matter. You were decisive in your judgment. There is nothing more to it.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: But I executed him without a trial, without permission—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Is it not normal for an officer to act first and report later under extraordinary circumstances?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We need not even carry out a court martial. Anyone with eyes would approve of your difficult decision.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Then will Platon's family be implicated?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I can only say that I did not hear anything about his family inciting him to act this way in your report just now.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: But this does not mean any guarantees as to their fate.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What do you mean?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Once more, you look only at the 'truth', without making an effort to piece together the cause behind it, correct?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: When Count Lunin first began dealing with your father several years ago, he was an honorary citizen who could only support a small workshop, but he has now become a new noble, with textile factories spanning several districts of Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I fear nobody would see this rate of progress and think he did it by his own effort. And when the partner he relied on lost his glory, and could not render more aid—
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: No matter if he managed to devour the hand that once fed him, or if they fall together, the shift in resources resulting from this commotion will not flow down to those who never had anything to begin with.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: This is the greatest problem our modern nation faces. No matter how much bread we may produce in aggregate, we cannot ensure it reaches everyone.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We cannot fill the bellies... of all our people.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Which is why you should not be worrying about whether people will suddenly fall from grace due to your actions.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: If you still wish to do something worthwhile, then consider my words carefully.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We must act, before even more people are fed into the insatiable machine that is the empire.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I must...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Eloy...sius.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Y-You're... back. Everyone's... okay. D-D-Don't worry.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Vetochki.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hmm?
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Where is the general?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: 'The g-general'? Wh-Who is that?
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: ...Is Gospodin Hellagur in?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: He's... r-reading books... with some of th-the little kids.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Little kids? Littler than you?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I-I'm... not... little!
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: In j-just a f-few months... I'll be sixteen!
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Sixteen. If you were the daughter of a noble, you'd have the formal right to inherit. A woman grown.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: B-But I'm not... and I d-don't want to be one.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Then do you want to go somewhere where you can tell your story, where you can fight for fair treatment for all your friends?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: We can... go and... t-testify?
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: D-Dur-nar said... the courthouse... is that sort of p-p-place.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: No, Vetochki. Not this time. I won't lie to you. You will not be going to testify.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: There is a bill called The Winter Emergency Resource Allocation Act, to be voted on in Grypherburg's first citizen's forum.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: If it passes, it will save the lives of countless people unable to keep themselves warm this winter, countless workers who lost their jobs due to lack of resources.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Before all that, you can go and give suggestions, tell them your story, raise support among the people. You will help the proposal pass. You will help your comrades.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Th-Then... I'll go.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: However, it means you will need to get up in front of everyone. There will be no lack of unsightly faces there, ones just like the 'lords' you saw during your time in the mines.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: This may also be very dangerous. The Infected are still not allowed to walk the streets unchaperoned, and you will make yourself stand out. Although Hellagur and I will protect you—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I-I'll still go!
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: I want to go. E-Even if it's d-dangerous, I'll go.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Alright then.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Then let me find a way to make them give you back the identity that should have been yours in the first place.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You're back.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Judging by the look on your face, did you get confirmation about something?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I have... received a whistleblower report.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: From Vasily's daughter.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Eloysius?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You remember her.
attributes.name: Witte
Fyodor
attributes.content: Because her mother gave her such a rare name.

attributes.name: Fyodor
attributes.content: Why would she report on her own father?
In her own words... 'This all has crossed my bottom line. I had to make a choice to prevent even more people from falling victim to my father's absurd schemes.'
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: This report—perhaps testimony—exposes his attempts to pull Duchess Volkina and the pro-war faction into an alliance. It is able to force him to be suspended pending inquiry, perhaps even be temporarily detained.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: But even if we exploit the fact that he has exposed an entry point into the interior of the pro-wars through his treachery, this will not touch on the root of the issue at hand...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I suggest sealing this report and all other results of related investigations, to be used at a later date.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: If we use that evidence to control him, then the vice-chairman's current behavior is no longer important.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Precisely.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: How interesting... First the students in Katorga, now the new generation of the Imperial Guard. The vast majority of our youth are awake now.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: But what about those stubborn, sundowning old men? Why do they still turn a blind eye to all the contradictions and challenges exposed by our lack of minerals? Why are they so devoted to making trouble for people outside their circle?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Are they not like a chronic illness plaguing Ursus...? When did our nation lose the strength to fight disease within?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty... Though you may see them as disease, they are also the flesh the empire demands.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Fortunately, we are witnessing a new power be born within this nation, even though they are still young sprouts unable to break through the permafrost... We wish them to have more time.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You're right... 'Disease' and 'flesh', who should be the one differentiating them?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: How do I ensure that, when this power emerges from the soil, I will not be seen by them as 'the chronic illness plaguing Ursus' myself?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Tell me plainly, Witte. How likely is The Winter Emergency Resource Allocation Act to pass, if things stay as they are?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If we only factor in the possibility of men following their good conscience, then thirty percent, no higher.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: As I have said before, there is no man who would willingly give up his own profits. What you aim to do will leave them one last bit of grace, though none of them will thank you for it.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Your magnanimity will be as pearls before meatbeasts.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: This will be their last chance.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If these beasts are still ungrateful, then this will be their last chance to use their 'innate authority' to sit at the table.
attributes.name: Fyodor
Raidian
attributes.content: The signal-blocking mechanism here is very strange...

attributes.name: Raidian
attributes.content: I can't guarantee that I've found the right place, but there shouldn't be any guards popping out to intercept us when we get out.
Let's focus on getting out first, then. At least we haven't heard any alarms.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We've been walking in the dark for ages now, Raidian. Where's this exit you were talking about?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: Do you have night vision, Mon3tr?

attributes.content: I mean, yes, but I might as well not have here. It's all just walls and stairs. No sight of even an emergency exit sign.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Can you tell what materials they're made of? Walls and doors have their differences. Even if they appear the same visually, their materials will let us tell them apart.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Look, but don't touch without proper caution. The doors may be electrified.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Hmm...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Ah, found one!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Oh, this is...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Light from outside? But aren't we underground? How did sunlight get through the ceiling?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Though it appears to be a courtyard, that light isn't natural light.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Secret installations such as these cannot simply add a real glass ceiling. It would be far too conspicuous from the surface.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: It reminds me a little of that research institute we visited in the Far North. The construction style, I mean.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But the impression I get is completely different...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: It's too quiet.;It doesn't feel stifling here.

attributes.content: Right...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Isn't that good?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: It looked that way from the outside, didn't it? But now we know the truth of the matter inside.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.options: Defenses here are strangely lax.;No Army Shieldguards like the one we saw earlier either.

attributes.content: I'll find us a route without anyone along it so we can scout this place out.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: It's so strange... We can't find any doors leading out.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's like a maze in here.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I don't think we can keep avoiding places with other people, Raidian.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: People may have their own unique body signal frequencies, but I can't rely on just that to determine if they're friendly on first contact.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Then we'll—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Gah!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Amiya!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: I've been watching you people for half an hour. A group suddenly appearing in the second floor halls, with some sort of goal in mind, but never actually leaving.
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: How did you get in here, and what're you trying to do?
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: Sir... Please, calm down, we're—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I want someone else talking.
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.options: We were sent here by the State Council!;We're here to help with Project Zero!

attributes.content: Don't be stupid. The scholars the State Council sent over were already assigned to their labs. You really think you can fool us?
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: I see. You must be spies who slipped in during that explosion outside!
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: Mind how you speak. We are from Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals, and have been dispatched by the State Council of the Ursine Empire. We are here to help with research into Project Zero's pharmaceutical applications.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Here is our warrant of appointment with the tsar's seal, as well as our documentation from the legislature. You'll find our Zelgrad immigration stamps there too.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: As for why we have been pacing about the halls, it is naturally because—
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Because we forgot how to get back.
Which lab are you from?
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: I'm the director of Lab Six.
Hah, Lab Six has already been dissolved. Even their director got banished. Who do you think you're trying to fool—
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: Here's my ID.
Alita Valueva...
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: If I were you, I'd ask others before I pick a theory to believe in.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Someone like your boss, Zina, for example. I believe she's in charge of security for the entire institute. She'd know who all the new staff in Lab Six are, surely?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: What do we do, boss?
attributes.name: Guard to the Back

attributes.content: Hail Zina on her channel and ask her!
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: Y-Y-Yes, sir!
attributes.name: Guard to the Back

attributes.content: The blonde researcher turns away from the guards, sweeping her eyes across the Rhode Islanders. Her eyes stop on you for a moment, before finally settling on Raidian.
I can't believe I forgot to get someone to show you the way out. Lab Four's not on this floor. I've been so busy these past few days, I'd forget my own head next.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Once this misunderstanding is all sorted out, I'll lead you there personally.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: ...We are grateful to you, really. And after you took the time to bring us up to speed on your project, too.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: I'll need to bring you around all the labs, then you'll see that New Lab Six's project is the one with the most resources at its disposal here.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Boss, Zina confirmed this is the name of New Lab Six's director.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Hmph!
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: Amiya!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: Once we see the Generalik, he'll know of what happened today.;Random questionings, seizing guests. I see how you treat others.

attributes.content: Move it!
attributes.name: Vigilant Guard

attributes.content: Well then... Madam Alita Valueva—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Not in a hurry to go? Come with me then.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: *cough*—Suka!
attributes.name: Anxious Officer

attributes.content: Who the hell are these people? How do they have so much firepower?!
attributes.name: Anxious Officer

attributes.content: It's all one individual's Arts! Saw it with my own eyes!
attributes.name: Nervous Soldier

attributes.content: You serious?
attributes.name: Anxious Officer

attributes.content: We need to get out of here right now, sir! They've smashed through everything in their way, none of our emplacements could hold them back longer than half a minute!
attributes.name: Nervous Soldier

attributes.content: Absolutely not! We were ordered to guard this place, and if any of you dare to take even one step back, I'm cutting off your legs—
attributes.name: Anxious Officer

attributes.content: Before he can finish, a scarlet streak flies past his nose, screeching as it slams into the wall behind him in a burst of flame, illuminating the dark, cramped 'factory'.
The officer locks in place, stiffly turning his neck until ice-cold steel presses up against his sweat-stained skin—
Stop.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: If you have even the slightest bit of a conscience, or a slimmer of remorse...
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I'll give you one chance. Out of the way.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Crossbow bolts whistle through the sky from all around her. One last volley from the desperate defenders.
Waves of flame flick their way up the bolt shafts, igniting the Originium in the bolt heads in an instant. They explode into amber smoke.
Talulah simply stands there, light and shadow flitting across her face. As the soldiers try to figure out what this expression means, wretched yells come from nearby—
First one, then another... More and more soldiers fall, and the yelling dies out alongside their breaths. Slowly but surely, all that remains is the sound of a sword being sheathed.
...I nearly forgot how you do things.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Forget the soldiers. More importantly, I don't see any researchers here.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Secret facilities like these almost certainly have emergency escape routes installed by the army. They most likely left the moment they heard about our activities.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Gather up the materials and all the clues you can find. They couldn't have taken away all the evidence in such a short amount of time.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I need your help, everyone.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Alright everyone, split up. If you notice anything, report it right away. Time is of the essence.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: The miners give her a shout of agreement before they separate into groups.
Closure stands away from them as she surveys the site of the battle just now. Everything has been reduced to piles of charcoal.
(Quietly) Is this what it was like to face her, Amiya...?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Did you say something, Closure?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: ...Ah, err, nothing.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Let's help them out, Tonya. The secrets you want to know are most likely going to be here, and who knows, we might find some meds for that weird disease!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Yeah, if it can help my sister—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: T-T-Tulin, no...
attributes.name: Stupefied Miner

attributes.content: What is it? Don't rush, take it slow.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Tsar's mercy... I-I, I...
attributes.name: Stupefied Miner

attributes.content: I'll take a look.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Red walks past the dumbstruck miner, pushing open the door behind him.
The smell of rust strikes him in the face. Part of it smells like blood, another part like iron steeped in water, and yet another part like rust heated to the point of burning, all mingling together—
Hand me a flashlight.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: What in the—?!
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: The crowd follows the beam of light with their eyes. The first thing they see is a giant glass vat, shattered in half... and whatever is inside it is leaking out.
Drip, drip... It spills, mixing with the dirt, gravel, and blackened clots of blood strewn across the ground.
There are fingers and toes, mud still staining them. There is a backbone, one that is stooped, hunched and elderly. There is—
An object, gently bumping against their boots before stopping.
Red looks down. It is a swollen, damaged, rubbery body, coated in an ashen gray. Half of a cheek presses against the ground, as two dark, empty sockets stare back at him.
He closes his eyes and stays silent. But even so, he feels something gaze at him from the abyss. It sees him stand there, sees him breathe, sees him live.
Until someone vomits.
Oh... What... What is this?!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: How could they... No...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: (Crying) Ueargh... *cough* *cough*—
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: (Crying) Red, please, shut that door, I'm begging you...
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: The voices of his comrade startle Red. With a tremble of his hand, the light shoots into the darkness... There, there are more vats.
Some are empty, spotless, as if they have been polished, washed, and tidied. Even the metal brackets below shine, reflecting back the light.
Some are not so empty.
Within the oily liquid, glistening Originium crystals shine as they jut out of butchered bodies, cluster by cluster, like bushes growing on sand.
(Weeping) Damn you, Red, you idiot... Damn you!
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: The man wails as he tries to wrestle the flashlight out of Red's hand, but try as he might, he cannot break Red's vice grip. The swaying light sweeps across the entire room.

Other Reunion members surround him, trying to pull away their comrade after he had lost his wits. But they cannot. More step forward. Everyone helps drag away the one man, his feet leaving two marks on the ground.
More of them sit on the floor in exhaustion, silently watching the scuffle as they let their tears flow freely.
These... What... What are...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Stupefied faces turn towards her, as flashlights illuminate another corner of the room.
Junk?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Personal effects, more like.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Bedding. Broken bowls. Blackened bread as hard as rock, yet still gnawed in half. Even golden dentures. All tossed into the corner.
As the footsteps approach, the pile is covered by the shadow of a frail woman.
Tonya kneels before the pile, her hands sifting through its ice-cold contents—and then she sees it. She knows this blanket... She would never be mistaken about it.
A blanket that was once wrapped tight around a child, the edges of the red cloth a faded white, now covered in a thin layer of dust—
Her little sister's.
She cradles it as if it were alive, pressing it against her cheek.

A blanket with nothing to wrap around, the smell of detergent and sweat still lingering in the fabric. She buries her face in it, her shoulders heaving up and down as the cloth slowly soaks in her tears.
Nina... My poor, poor Nina...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Tonya does not stop calling out her sister's name, as if saying it could bring her back to her. But there is too much spit clogging her throat, too many tears slipping into her mouth, so all she can choke out is a rasp.
Talulah does not turn away. She clenches her fists tight, so tight her arms begin to shake.
The shoulders of her shadow looming against the wall begin to heave as well, as if pressed down by something extraordinarily heavy.
Suddenly, they drop. She feels a rough, strong hand gently holding them down.
Talulah turns, and is greeted by a pair of mauve eyes. They do not look away, as unwavering as the hand on her shoulder.
...Tulin?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: They need you, Talulah. Need us.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Tulin nods towards the men. The miners cough as they see Tulin approach, trying to reset their emotions.
The youth gently consoles them, holds their hands, hugs them, helps pull up the ones laying on the ground... Though many of their faces are still stained with tears, they no longer tremble.
Then, Tulin heads towards someone else who is also relatively calm. Someone currently looking at the very first vat, lost in thought.
Have you found anything, Closure?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I noticed all the vats have cables and tubes attached to them... I'm afraid I don't know much about this topic. Do you know what the military might have been doing to the Infected?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I inspected them just now.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: These machines are strange, but I can see the readings on the meters...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: They were calculating how much Originium these Infected would turn into after they died.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: They were turning the Infected into 'fuel' to combat the Originium shortage.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: That's... That's my best guess, yeah.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But Tonya's sister wasn't Infected, she just caught that strange disease. But her blanket's here all the same...
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I noticed many of the bodies here have the same symptoms.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Look at these remains from the first vat. Ulcerated pustules, covered in green scars. Clearly the disease Tonya talked about, but no signs of Oripathy.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The First Army was obviously researching this new disease, and it just so happened to show up after Zelgrad revised their Infected policy.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: You said the Sarcophagus might have released some disease that seems infectious. If they're gathering the Infected to sacrifice them for Sarcophagus research, this 'strange disease' must be related to it.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: We need to tell everyone the truth about this 'Sarcophagus' right away.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: The First Army let this disease spread freely, which means everyone's lives are in danger. We have to get them out of here.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: We can't hide our raid from the army for very long. They'll have a response soon enough.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: But if we just need to stall for time and protect you as you evacuate, then Reunion can do that.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Let's not waste time, then. We need to—
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Tulin sees Closure give a faint shake of the head. She hesitantly walks to Tonya, still rooted to the floor, before stretching out her hand.
...Closure?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Sorry... I'm really not good at giving pep talks.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Err... Right, you said you never saw a Sarkaz before, yeah? Well I'm a Sarkaz from Kazdel, real old school.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Kazdel's a lot worse off compared to Zelgrad. Maybe only half the kids in the city have a roof over their heads... and only half of the kids ever get to grow up.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But even so, we still call Kazdel home.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Eventually, we built a lot more houses, and planted a lot more crops. There was also one amazing person who got everyone together to research medicine that could actually treat the pain of Oripathy...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: When everyone worked together, life really did get better... We all treasure our home.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Tonya slowly lifts her head as she looks at the Vampire before her, meeting her teary gaze.
I'm really sorry that... Zelgrad couldn't be a place like that for you. But there'll definitely be a day you find somewhere you can really call 'home'.
attributes.name: Closure
Closure
attributes.content: Nina... couldn't make it to that day.

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: But if you work alongside us, Tonya, there'll be lots of other kids who can.
After a moment of silence, Tonya grabs onto Closure's hand and pulls herself up.
This place... is right by the district I live in.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I can... I...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I'll go with you... and get everyone out of here.
attributes.name: Tonya
